item.title: CENTCOM chief: Strait of Hormuz shipping lanes now free of Iranian mines
item.description: In an operational update, CENTCOM Commander Adm. Brad Cooper says US forces cleared Iranian sea mines from Strait of Hormuz shipping lanes amid an ongoing naval blockade.

item.title: Suspected yellow scorpion sting in Arad: Four-year-old in serious condition
item.description:
A four-year-old boy was taken to Soroka Hospital in serious condition after he was apparently stung by a yellow scorpion in Arad.
Magen David Adom teams treated the boy and transported him to the hospital.

item.title: Terrorist who held Edan Alexander, Matan Zangauker, & Avera Mengistu eliminated

item.title: Katz threatens: Ultimatum has ended, every launch will be met with force
item.description: Defense Minister announces that the ultimatum has expired and makes clear: Every launch of balloons or kites from Gaza will be considered an act of terrorism and met with force.

item.title: Medical History: Israeli surgeons replace teenager’s pelvis in 19-hour operation
item.description: Doctors in Israel have pulled off a groundbreaking medical feat, removing half of a 15-year-old cancer patient’s pelvis and replacing it with a custom 3D-printed implant designed to restore his mobility.
